samples.xml_description: Implement an unsigned 8bit multiplier based on pipelining processing. Clock signal used for synchronous operation. Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive. Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation. Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits. Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits. Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled. Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits. 8 16 mul_en_out_reg is a 3-bit register that stores the input enable signal mul_en_in. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. The register is used to control the output enable signal mul_en_out. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, mul_en_out_reg is reset to 0. Otherwise, mul_en_out_reg is updated to the concatenation of its previous two bits and the current value of mul_en_in. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin mul_en_out_reg <= 3'b0; end else begin mul_en_out_reg <= {mul_en_out_reg[1:0], mul_en_in}; end end mul_en_out is the output enable signal that indicates if the multiplication operation is enabled. It is derived from the most significant bit of mul_en_out_reg. mul_en_out is asserted when the most significant bit of mul_en_out_reg is 1, indicating that the multiplication operation is enabled. assign mul_en_out = mul_en_out_reg[2]; mul_a_reg is a 8-bit register that stores the input multiplicand signal mul_a. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, mul_a_reg is reset to 0. Otherwise, mul_a_reg is updated to the value of mul_a. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin mul_a_reg <= 8'b0; end else begin mul_a_reg <= mul_a; end end mul_b_reg is a 8-bit register that stores the input multiplier signal mul_b. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, mul_b_reg is reset to 0. Otherwise, mul_b_reg is updated to the value of mul_b. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin mul_b_reg <= 8'b0; end else begin mul_b_reg <= mul_b; end end temp is a 8-bit wide wire array that stores the partial products generated by the bitwise AND operations between the bits of mul_a_reg and mul_b_reg. Each element of temp corresponds to a different bit position. wire [WIDTH-1:0] temp[0:WIDTH-1]; Each element of temp is assigned based on the corresponding bit of mul_b_reg. If the bit is 1, the corresponding element of temp is assigned the value of mul_a_reg. If the bit is 0, the corresponding element of temp is assigned 0. assign temp[0] = mul_b_reg[0] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[1] = mul_b_reg[1] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[2] = mul_b_reg[2] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[3] = mul_b_reg[3] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[4] = mul_b_reg[4] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[5] = mul_b_reg[5] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[6] = mul_b_reg[6] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; assign temp[7] = mul_b_reg[7] ? mul_a_reg : 8'b0; sum[0] is a 9-bit register that stores the partial sum generated by the addition of temp[0] and temp[1]. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, sum[0] is reset to 0. Otherwise, sum[0] is updated to the sum of temp[0] and temp[1]. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin sum[0] <= 9'b0; end else begin sum[0] <= temp[0] + temp[1]; end end sum[1] is a 9-bit register that stores the partial sum generated by the addition of temp[2] and temp[3]. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, sum[1] is reset to 0. Otherwise, sum[1] is updated to the sum of temp[2] and temp[3]. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin sum[1] <= 9'b0; end else begin sum[1] <= temp[2] + temp[3]; end end sum[2] is a 9-bit register that stores the partial sum generated by the addition of temp[4] and temp[5]. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, sum[2] is reset to 0. Otherwise, sum[2] is updated to the sum of temp[4] and temp[5]. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin sum[2] <= 9'b0; end else begin sum[2] <= temp[4] + temp[5]; end end sum[3] is a 9-bit register that stores the partial sum generated by the addition of temp[6] and temp[7]. It is updated on the positive edge of the clock signal and reset to 0 when rst_n is 0. On the positive edge of the clock signal, if rst_n is 0, sum[3] is reset to 0. Otherwise, sum[3] is updated to the sum of temp[6] and temp[7]. always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) begin sum[3] <= 9'b0; end else begin sum[3] <= temp[6] + temp[7]; end end </
